results.contents:
Join our data platform group and help build dependable services used across the organisation.

What you will do

  • Design and operate batch and streaming pipelines using Python and SQL.
  • Improve data quality, observability, automated testing, and production support.
  • Work with analysts and application engineers on clear data contracts.

What we need

You have experience delivering production data systems, reviewing technical designs, explaining trade-offs, and improving services over time. Cloud and infrastructure-as-code experience would be useful.
results.name: Senior Data Engineer
